samples.note: An unfamiliar narrative advisory with several numbers; only the detection sentence states the rule (5 failures / 2 minutes).
Counts distinct accounts (not attempts) per source host.
The report talks about people using an account 'at once'; the rule counts distinct hosts and says it cannot measure overlap.
Fires on ANY mismatch with the expected method - the report says 'in either direction'.
Detects a missing second factor, not a bypass technique.
The regression case for the audit's headline defect: '90 seconds' must compile to 90 s, never 90 minutes.
Counts destination ports - no supported behaviour does; the audit's silent false accept.
Needs geo_country, which the authentication log does not provide.
Two different windows for one rule: an unresolved contradiction is rejected, not resolved by guessing.
No threshold and no window: nothing is invented; a person must supply them (see Refine).
